creator: Ka Fai Lao
title: Kelvin's Glove80 layout v48
notes:
Kelvin's Glove80 layout v48.

Key Features:
- Bilateral Home Row Mods (hml/hmr): A/S/D/F and J/K/L/; (GUI, Alt, Ctrl, Shift) with 280ms tapping term, 250ms quick-tap, 150ms prior-idle, and opposite-hand trigger.
- Left Outer Column (Modes & System): td_LAYER_Keypad (Row 1), td_caps (Row 2), ESC (Row 3), Mouse layer toggle (Row 4), Magic (Row 5).
- Right Outer Column (Punctuation & Nav): Screenshot tap dance (Row 1), Hyphen - (Row 2), Quote ' (Row 3), Underscore _ (Row 4), End (Row 5).
- Thumb Cluster:
  - Left Lower (Outer to Inner): LSHFT, BSPC (pure instant key), TAB (hold for NumRow).
  - Right Lower (Inner to Outer): RET, DEL (hold for SymbolNav), SPACE.
  - Left Upper (Outer to Inner): LCTRL, LALT, LGUI.
  - Right Upper (Inner to Outer): Volume Down, Volume Up, Media (Tap: Play/Pause, 2x: Next, 3x: Prev; Combo Vol Dn+Up: Mute).

Layers:
- Base: macOS base layer (Keypad on top-left, Mouse toggle on Row 4, Magic on Row 5, Browser history tap-dance (1x: ⌘⌥H Back, 2x: ⌘⌥L Forward), Copy/Paste tap-dance (1x: ⌘C, 2x: ⌘V, 3x: ⌘⌥V Clippy), Left, Right on bottom-left; Down, Up, Launcher tap-dance (⌘Space/⌘⇧Space), WM Prev tap-dance (1x: ⌃⌘⇧U Prev Window, 2x: ⌃⌘, Prev Workspace), WM Next tap-dance (1x: ⌃⌘u Next Window, 2x: ⌃⌘. Next Workspace) on bottom-right; combo WM Prev + WM Next (Home+End): Maximize Window (⌃⌘M); CleanShot X Screenshot tap-dance on number-row corner).
- PC: Linux/Windows overlay layer (converts bottom-row shortcuts to Ctrl+C/V/Win+V tap-dance, passes through Window Manager shortcuts to Win+Ctrl+U/./M). Mirrors Base layer RGB highlights with td_copy_paste_pc lit in White (instead of Gold) for 3 seconds then fading out.
- Gaming: Disables Home Row Mods on ASDF / JKL;, keeps TAB at left of Q, puts ` (Grave) above Tab (Row 1), ~ (Tilde) to left of Z (Row 4), restores Magic to bottom-left corner, puts BSPC, DEL (pure key), and LGUI (Cmd/Super) on bottom-left, and uses LSHFT (pass-through), Hold-Tap Ctrl/Space, and Hold-Tap Alt/Ret on left thumb.
- SymbolNav: Left-hand brackets/quotes/symbols, Home/End on left outer column (left of @ and ~), Right-hand Vim HJKL arrows, math/comparison operators (& + - * \ and = ^ < > $), F1-F12, and PageUp/PageDown below F12.
- Keypad: 3x3 digit block shifted right to UJM (741), IK, (852), OL. (963) with 456 on home-row JKL. 0 on Down, . on Up, single Enter on right Space thumb. Equal (=) on N matching SymbolNav. All duplicate Enters, Backspaces, and 0/. removed. Left pinky toggles off.
- NumRow: Hold Left Thumb T6 (TAB) for home-row numbers 1-0 on A-G / H-; with all other keys transparent.
- Magic: Volume on U/I/O (Dn/Up/Mute), Bluetooth profiles (BT_0 -> Base/macOS, BT_1 -> PC/Linux-Win), layer toggles (PC, Gaming), RGB controls, Insert/ScrollLock/PrintScreen on right bottom row, and bootloader/reset.
- Mouse / Sniper: Mouse toggle key enters mouse layer; home-row HJKL mouse movement; hold A for Sniper precision mode.

Per-Key RGB (underglow-layer):
- Base layer: Special keys highlighted (Layers in Red, Modifiers & Home Row Mods in Blue, Tap Dances in Gold, Magic in Magenta), lighting up for 3 seconds on wake or layer return then fading out.
- Momentary layers (SymbolNav, NumRow, Magic, Mouse, Sniper) and Keypad stay color-coded while active (Navigation in Green, Numbers & F-keys in Yellow, Brackets / Braces / Parentheses / Regular Symbols / Double Quote / Keypad in White, Mouse Clicks & Back/Forward in Green, Escape & Layer switches in Red, Magic Media/Volume in Cyan, Sniper movement in Red).
- Permanent layers (PC, Gaming) light up for 3 seconds on toggle and fade out (PC mirrors Base layer with copy/paste in White; Gaming only lights up Magic in Magenta and modifiers in Blue, with plain gaming keys and non-modifiers unlit).
